scripts.feedback: tsx src/cli.ts package-feedback -o workspace/artifacts raw-assignments workspace/subs
scripts.mark: tsx src/cli.ts package-mark -b $(cat workspace/TOTAL_MARK) -o workspace/artifacts workspace/subs
scripts.usage:
printf '
1: Run pnpm pre <submissions.zip>
2: Mark the submissions in the workspace folder (use markit skill with claude or whatever agent)
3: Run pnpm post and follow instructions to enter the mark and attach feedback

'
scripts.pre: sh -c 'rm -rf raw-assignments/* && mkdir -p raw-assignments && ditto -x -k "$1" raw-assignments && pnpm new-ws && pnpm organize' --
scripts.post: pnpm summarize && pnpm feedback && pnpm mark && pnpm d2l
